articles.title: $72B in Ether sits exposed to quantum attack
articles.summary: Researchers found that about 42 million ether, worth roughly $72 billion, sits in wallets whose public keys are already exposed to a future quantum computer. Their fix could take months to roll out, and no major exchange they reviewed had a compatible backup. CoinDesk's Uyen Truong hosts "CoinDesk Daily."
